name: wrapper
description: Per-frame envelope that carries the body, the HMAC chain, and the Ed25519 signature. Defined in spec/sbtrace-v1.md §5.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Frame body (header / capability / step / blob / tail). Discriminated by body.type.

fields.name: prev_hmac
fields.description: 64 lowercase hex chars: HMAC of the previous frame, or 64 zeros for the first frame.

fields.name: hmac
fields.description: 64 lowercase hex chars: HMAC_SHA256(K_h, prev_hmac_bytes || canonical_json(body)).

fields.name: sig
fields.description: Signature envelope, 'ed25519:' + lowercase hex of Ed25519_sign(K_s, hmac_bytes).

extension_ranges.description: Wrapper fields are extremely tightly scoped; only the four fields above are defined in v1.
Reserved for registered capabilities such as a future per-frame encoding tag (e.g. v2's 'enc' selector).
Vendor-private. Readers MUST ignore unknown experimental wrapper fields when verifying.
